answer: Random guarantor pairing: each epoch a public beacon pairs every new identity with two established strangers. Each must post a walnut-sized bond, say 1% of their balance, to co-sign the newcomer, or decline. If the newcomer is later exposed as a sybil, both bonds burn. Because a farm can't choose friendly sponsors, every guarantor has a reason to check hard. Climbing from the bottom ledge to zenith-tier rewards takes six epochs of co-signed history. Assumption: pairings are unpredictable and bonds outweigh likely bribes.
